canonical_statement: For every finite m-by-n real matrix and every finite m-by-n complex matrix, there exist square orthogonal or unitary matrices U and V and a conforming rectangular diagonal matrix whose min(m,n) real diagonal entries are nonnegative such that A = U * Sigma * V*.
domain_and_universes: Closed conjunction of the Real and Complex cases; m n : Nat; A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) K; the helper IsFullSVD is universe-polymorphic, while the exact root is Prop in universe 0.
ordered_binders: A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) Real or Complex
conclusion: There exist square U and V and real sigma such that U and V belong to their unitary groups, every sigma entry is nonnegative, and with Sigma(i,j) equal to the embedded sigma(i) when i.val = j.val and zero otherwise, IsRectangularDiagonal Sigma and A = U * Sigma * star V.
minimal_import_evidence: Complex.Basic supplies the closed Real and Complex scalar instances and real-to-complex coercion; UnitaryGroup supplies Matrix.unitaryGroup. The SingularValues and spectral modules are not required to state the target.
